_note: Routing corpus of record for meta-app-scaffold — scaffold an apps/{name}/ reference-app FOUNDATION (borrowed plugin folder layout + spec/ plan/ app/ axes + minimal seed files), then PROPOSE a sibling-skill chain (it seeds folders, it does not author content). Positives span the invocation families (imperative scaffold/bootstrap, object-first 'apps/{name}', 'new playground/demo', reverse-engineer an existing app, indirect-paraphrase). Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from NAMED siblings: skills-studio (AUTHOR / score / critique / eval a SKILL), skills-refactor (rename/merge/retire/split an existing skill across the library), plugin-decomposer (a PLUGIN bundle/manifest), meta-expert-author + meta-theory-author (author a [domain]-expert KNOWLEDGE skill — what THIS skill chains TO for content, not what it does), plan-spec/plan-prd (author the spec docs), ops-repo (audit existing repo docs in place). Each negative belongs to one named sibling, in its vocabulary. routing-eval measures LEXICAL overlap only — paraphrase positives may miss; a proxy limit, not a defect.
